items.title: 14.14 Hawa ki aaloodgi ghatane ki hikmat-e-amliyan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.14 with Figure 14.6, printed pages 317-318.

blocks.text: Hawa ki aaloodgi ghatane aur hawa ka mayar behtar karne ke liye mukhtalif technologies istemal hoti hain. Air pollutants ke ikhraj par qaboo pane ke liye yeh istemal hoti hain.

items: Catalytic converter: gariyon ke engines nitrogen ke oxides, CO aur bina jale hydrocarbons kharij karte hain; zyada tar cars mein catalytic converters hote hain jo in nuqsan-deh pollutants ko be-zarar maddon mein badalte hain: CO CO2 mein oxidise, NOx N2 mein reduce, aur bina jale hydrocarbons CO2 aur H2O mein.

Diesel particulate filter (DPF): jadeed diesel engines mein exhaust gases se nuqsan-deh particulate matter ka ikhraj ghatane ke liye lagaya jata hai; us ka bunyadi kaam exhaust gases se kajal ke zarraat pakarna aur jama karna hai.

Selective catalytic reduction (SCR): diesel engines mein ikhraj ki gases se pollutants hatane ke liye; yeh TiO2 aur zeolites jaise catalysts se NOx ko N2 mein reduce aur CO aur hydrocarbons ko CO2 aur pani ke bukharat mein oxidise karta hai (Figure 14.6).
Scrubbers: particulate matter, SO2, HCl, NH3 aur VOCs samet pollutants ki wasee range par qaboo pate hain; yeh sanati exhaust gases se SO2 aur PM hatane ke liye pani jaise liquids istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Catalytic converter gariyon ke nuqsan-deh ikhraj kaise ghatata hai, aur hawa ki aaloodgi ghatane ki doosri hikmat-e-amliyan kya hain (exercise Q.2l)?
blocks.explanation: Chhatte par platinum group ki dhatein carbon monoxide ko carbon dioxide mein, bina jale hydrocarbons ko carbon dioxide aur pani mein oxidise karti hain, aur nitrogen oxides ko nitrogen mein reduce karti hain, sab exhaust ke gari se nikalne se pehle. Doosri hikmat-e-amliyan diesels par diesel particulate filters aur selective catalytic reduction, factory ki chimniyon par scrubbers, CNG, LPG aur kam-sulfur diesel jaise saaf fuels, aur qabil-e-tajdeed energy hain jo jalne se bilkul bachti hai.

items: Technologies: catalytic converter (CO se CO2, NOx se N2, HC se CO2 + H2O); diesel particulate filter (kajal); selective catalytic reduction (TiO2, zeolites par NOx se N2); scrubbers (pani se PM, SO2, HCl, NH3, VOCs).
